summary: Plan relief pipelines, control stocks and report delivery constraints. Explore this practical five-day disaster logistics course.
lede: Disaster relief logistics training helps logistics coordinators, supply officers and response managers move essential goods when routes, demand and supply are uncertain. Participants practise prioritising needs, mapping supply pipelines, controlling relief stocks and comparing route options, then use Excel to track delivery indicators and report constraints and progress.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who coordinate emergency supply flows, relief distribution or the operational handoffs that connect them.
modules: Relief KPI Reporting and Response Review
prerequisites: Prior work exposure to logistics, procurement, warehousing, transport or emergency response operations is recommended. No coding or programming is required.
